title: Do fish ever get seasick?
html_source: Intriguing. An illustration of Bloom’s curious but uncomplicated mind.

anchor.prefix: Hanging on to a plank or astride of a beam for grim life, lifebelt round round him, gulping salt water, and that's the last 1961#378of his nibs till the sharks catch hold of him.
anchor.suffix:
Then you have a beautiful calm without a cloud, smooth sea, placid, crew and cargo in smithereens, Davy Jones' locker, moon looking down. Not my fault, old cockalorum. 

1932#3
